templates.name: GitHub Actions v3 Deploy (static)
templates.description: v3.0.0 TBR+deploy: pair test-build-release-static.yml with this deploy.yml (workflow_run). Uses danielvm-git/.github/actions/bigbase-deploy@v1. North star (e82): CI uploads built artifact — host unpacks, no VPS rebuild. Do not promise multipart until e82 ships.
templates.content:
name: Deploy
# v3.0.0 — copy to .github/workflows/deploy.yml; triggered by Test Build Release only
# Pair with: danielvm-git/.github workflow-templates/test-build-release-static.yml
# Note (e82): artifact multipart upload is the next platform capability — today deploy-meta carries SHA only

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Test Build Release"]
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: deploy-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  SITE_URL: "https://CHANGE-ME.bigbase.click"

jobs:
  deploy:
    if: >
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Download deploy-meta artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: deploy-meta
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          repository: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.repository.full_name }}
          path: deploy-meta

      - name: Verify deploy-meta artifact
        id: meta
        run: |
          if [ ! -s deploy-meta/deploy-meta.json ]; then
            echo "::error::deploy-meta artifact missing or empty"
            exit 1
          fi
          REF=$(jq -r '.sha' deploy-meta/deploy-meta.json)
          APP_TYPE=$(jq -r '.app_type' deploy-meta/deploy-meta.json)
          echo "ref=$REF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app_type=$APP_TYPE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Deploy to BigBase
        uses: danielvm-git/.github/actions/bigbase-deploy@v1
        with:
          site_id: ${{ secrets.BIGBASE_SITE_ID }}
          app_type: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.app_type }}
          site_url: ${{ env.SITE_URL }}
          deploy_token: ${{ secrets.BIGBASE_DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.ref }}
          branch: main
